facts.claim: (1) POST /text/compare runs in this order: require_paid_route_user (dependency), then the 10/min limiter, then consume_comparison_credit, then compare_from_text. On the q= path the LLM parse (parse_product_query, through _parse_with_budget) runs before _resolve_pair_category knows the category. The deterministic path covers only explicit_pair and vision, plus the flag-gated presplit.

facts.claim: (3) The client fingerprint is SHA-256 of applicationId | (Device.osBuildId ?? osInternalBuildId) | a random UUID nonce kept in SecureStore, generated in deviceFingerprint.ts. The X-Device-Fingerprint header is sent only on register, social sign-in and share, never on compare routes (api.ts).

facts.correction: The composition and the generation site are as claimed. The header goes out only on register, email/social sign-in (two sites) and Apple sign-in. Share carries the hash in the request body (referralService.ts:36), not in X-Device-Fingerprint. Compare routes send neither, so the backend anon gate could never see a fingerprint from the app on compare.
